findings.detail: The actual bridge.create_parent_stage path selects core source_inputs unchanged through _core_source_refs and passes the typed 1610-entry source roster to build_parent_stage. The first entry is a valid sealed provenance record with path, role, and sha256; build_parent_stage calls _stage_ref, whose stable_read invokes _ref. _ref intentionally accepts only path, sha256, rows, and stat, so it fails closed on the extra role field before stage inventory construction. The declared SHA and live first-file SHA match, so this is a schema-boundary mismatch rather than source-file corruption.
findings.required_correction: Prepare a new append-only successor with a narrow boundary normalization from the reviewed typed source roster to strict stage refs containing only the accepted path/SHA/stat/rows fields. Preserve the complete source roster, role metadata, order, count, and original source-input/closure digests in their existing provenance authority; do not widen _ref to accept arbitrary fields, drop roles, reorder entries, rewrite hashes, or use a path-only/global fallback. Add focused positive and near-miss coverage for typed-record normalization, extra-field rejection at the strict boundary, changed/missing/reordered entries, and inventory restoration before any new actual invocation.
